meta.name: Noir Console Design System
meta.purpose: Authoritative reference for AI-assisted feature development. Every value here is exact and implementation-ready. Do not deviate from these tokens without explicit product direction.
meta.visual_character: Premium dark-mode command-center dashboard. Layered charcoal surfaces, thin borders, rounded modular panels, electric blue interactive accents, restrained neon status colors. Dense but calm — like professional instrumentation. Never playful, never light-mode-inverted.

principles: Dark first: every screen must feel native to a black/charcoal environment — not a light UI inverted.
Modular panels: compose layouts from stacked rounded cards with clear hierarchy. Every panel should feel like an embedded hardware module.
Subtle contrast: express depth through borders, shadows, and small tonal shifts — never bright dividers.
Blue is the action language: reserve electric blue exclusively for primary actions, active/selected states, progress fills, focus rings, and navigation indicators.
Dense but calm: rich information is acceptable, but spacing, alignment, and typography must remain rigidly disciplined.
Minimal ornament: decoration comes from data, icons, subtle depth, and micro-interactions — never illustrations or loud gradients.
Soft tech premium: geometric precision + rounded edges + low-glow lighting.
do: Use charcoal-on-black layering for all surfaces.
Keep blue reserved strictly for interaction and selection.
Use small but highly legible typography.
Use status chips to communicate categories and states.
Use tabular numbers for all data, stats, and financial values.
dont: Never use pure black panels without a border — they will visually disappear.
Never overuse gradients or saturated colors outside of avatars.
Never use large or playful typography.
Never use heavy white dividers — use rgba(255,255,255,0.04) hairlines instead.
Never let cards float randomly — every layout must feel engineered on a grid.
Never use blue for decorative or informational-only elements.

colors._comment: All values are hex strings. Use rgba() strings for transparent values. These are the only approved colors.

typography._comment: React Native font weights must be string literals. Inter weight 450 maps to '400'; weight 650 maps to '600'. letterSpacing in RN is absolute (pt), not em — values below are pre-calculated for each size. Use fontVariant: ['tabular-nums'] for all numeric data.

display.usage: Hero numbers, empty-state titles, splash screens only

h2.usage: Section titles, card headers, modal titles

h3.usage: Subsections, list group headers, card titles

label.usage: Chips, tags, table column headers, section labels (use sentence case; uppercase only for very compact labels)

micro.usage: Dense UI labels, chart axis ticks, badge text, stat support text

mono.usage: Code snippets, API keys, version strings, hash values

rules.numeric_data: Always use fontVariant: ['tabular-nums'] for stats, prices, counts, percentages, timers, and table cells containing numbers.
rules.case: Sentence case everywhere. UPPERCASE only for micro/label in very compact contexts like section headers.
rules.anti_aliasing: Set fontSmoothing to auto in styles; RN handles iOS subpixel rendering automatically.
rules.color_defaults: Default all text to colors.text.primary. Use secondary for supporting text, tertiary for meta/captions, disabled for inactive.

spacing._comment: All values in logical pixels. Base unit is 4pt. Always align to this grid.

rules: Most interactive components (buttons, inputs, icon buttons): borderRadius 10.
Outer screen containers, bottom sheets: borderRadius 22.

elevation._comment: React Native iOS shadow props. Android elevation equivalent included. Do not use box-shadow equivalents — use these props on View.

panel._inset_highlight: Simulate the 1px top inset highlight with a borderTopColor of rgba(255,255,255,0.04) at 1px width

active_glow._note: Blue ring + glow for focused/active elements. Compose with borderColor and shadow.

motion._comment: Use React Native Animated API. No CSS transitions. Timing functions map to Animated.timing with Easing.

patterns.button_press: Scale to 0.98, duration 120ms fast easing on press-in; restore on press-out.
patterns.card_focus: Border color animates to focus blue over 180ms.
patterns.nav_indicator: Translate/slide the active indicator — never fade abruptly.
patterns.chart_draw: Animated path stroke-dashoffset from full length to 0, 260ms, left-to-right.
patterns.toggle: Translate thumb over 180ms; change track color over 180ms simultaneously.
patterns.modal_slide_in: Slide up from bottom + fade scrim in over 260ms.
patterns.toast_appear: Slide down from top + opacity 0→1 over 180ms; auto-dismiss after 3000ms.

setup: Load Inter and IBM Plex Mono via expo-font or react-native-font before rendering.
Use SafeAreaView (from react-native-safe-area-context) as the root of every screen.
Set backgroundColor: '#0F1011' as the root View background on every screen — never rely on the OS default.
Use StatusBar style='light-content' on all screens.
layout_primitives: Use React Native StyleSheet.create() for all styles — avoid inline styles except for dynamic values.
FlexDirection defaults to 'column' in RN — this matches the design's vertical card-stacking pattern.
Use gap property (RN 0.71+) or manually set marginBottom on children within columns.
All dimensions are in logical pixels (dp on Android, pt on iOS) — do not append 'px'.
shadows: On iOS: use shadowColor, shadowOffset, shadowOpacity, shadowRadius.
On Android: use elevation. Shadows render differently — test on both.
overflow: 'hidden' cancels shadows on iOS — avoid on shadow-bearing containers.
borders: RN does not support border shorthand. Use borderWidth + borderColor, or individual side properties.
For hairline dividers use StyleSheet.hairlineWidth for 0.5px lines rather than 1.
fonts: fontWeight must be a string: '400', '500', '600', '700'. RN does not support '450' or '650'.
letterSpacing is absolute in points, not em. Pre-calculated values are in the typography.scale section.
fontVariant: ['tabular-nums'] for all numeric data displays.
pressable_states: Use Pressable with style={({ pressed }) => ...} to apply pressed background color changes.
pressed state: reduce opacity to 0.85 OR switch background to the pressed color token — not both.
Never use TouchableOpacity opacity reduction on containers with text — it looks washed out at dark opacity levels. Prefer background color change.
icons: Use react-native-svg with stroke-based icons only. Stroke width 1.7, strokeLinecap 'round', strokeLinejoin 'round', fill 'none'.
Default icon sizes: 16, 18, 20, 22, 24pt. Match to the component context.
Default icon color: colors.text.secondary (#A7ADB5). Active: colors.brand.bright (#4BA4FE). Danger: colors.status.danger (#E36259).
scroll_views: Use ScrollView with showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} and contentContainerStyle for screen-level scrolling.
Add contentContainerStyle paddingBottom of at least 80 to clear the bottom navigation bar.
Use FlatList for lists longer than ~15 items.

AppShell.description: Root screen container. Dark canvas with safe-area insets, hosts all major surfaces.

TopBar.description: Compact sticky screen header with title, optional subtitle, and 1–3 action buttons on the right.
TopBar.usage: Actions: 1–3 icon buttons or one compact primary button. Never more than one primary CTA in the header.

BottomNavigation.description: Fixed bottom tab bar. Dark elevated pill with 4–5 items. Active item has blue icon + small dot indicator.
BottomNavigation.usage: Always 4–5 tabs. No text label is required for very compact nav bars. Never use more than 5 items.

Card.description: Primary content container. Appears as a compact hardware module embedded in the dark canvas.
Card.usage: Use as the standard building block for any grouped content. Stack cards vertically with 12pt gaps.

StatCard.description: Compact metric display. Shows a label, large numeric value, supporting text, and an optional badge in the top-right corner.
StatCard.layout: 2 or 4 stat cards per row on iPhone. Use equal flex: 1 within a row wrapper.
StatCard.usage: Revenue, user counts, uptime, win rates, XP, subscriptions, session counts.

ButtonPrimary.description: Main call-to-action button. Electric blue background, white text. Use sparingly — maximum one per view section.

ButtonSecondary.description: Secondary action. Dark surface with border, primary text. Pairs alongside ButtonPrimary.

ButtonGhost.description: Tertiary action with no background. Secondary text color. Used in toolbars and inline contexts.

ButtonDanger.description: Destructive action. Red-tinted background with red text and border. Always confirm before executing.

IconButton.description: Square icon-only button. Used for toolbar actions, overflow menus, and inline controls.

TextInput.description: Standard single-line text field. Dark elevated background, subtle border, blue focus ring.

TextArea.description: Multi-line text input. Same styling as TextInput but vertically expandable.

SearchBar.description: Low-contrast embedded search field with left search icon and muted placeholder. Does not show a border on focus — stays visually quiet.

Picker.description: Single-select dropdown. On iOS prefer a Picker presented in a Modal/ActionSheet rather than native HTML select.
Picker.rn_component: Pressable (opens Modal with Picker or ActionSheet)

Toggle.description: iOS-style on/off switch. Track animates from charcoal to brand blue; thumb slides from left to right.
Toggle.rn_component: Use React Native Switch component with custom colors, or Pressable with Animated.Value

Checkbox.description: Square checkbox with rounded corners. Animates fill to blue with a white checkmark on check.

checkmark._note: Render as a rotated L-shape using two View borders or an SVG checkmark icon in white

RadioButton.description: Circular single-select control. Ring border animates to blue; inner dot appears on selection.
RadioButton.rn_component: Pressable (row) + View (outer ring) + View (inner dot) + Text

SegmentedControl.description: Inline tab switcher. Dark container with a sliding active segment that has a subtle shadow lift.

Slider.description: Horizontal range selector. Blue thumb with glow on a dark track.

Badge.description: Pill-shaped status label. Non-interactive. Communicates state at a glance.

Chip.description: Interactive filter/tag pill. Toggleable. Can contain a leading icon and/or trailing close icon.
Chip.rn_component: Pressable + optional Icon + Text + optional Icon

ProgressBar.description: Thin horizontal progress indicator. Use color variants to signal health state.
ProgressBar.animation: Animate width via Animated.timing with duration 260ms

ListItem.description: Universal row for lists and menus. Leading icon/avatar, title + subtitle block, trailing badge/chevron/action.

DenseList.description: Data-dense table-style list. Used for analytics, transaction history, user tables. On phones, renders as stacked rows rather than horizontal table columns.

Avatar.description: Circular user/entity identifier. Shows initials or image. Has 4 sizes and a stack mode.

stack.description: Overlapping avatar row with overflow count badge

MenuCard.description: Feature entry point row. Taller than a list item with a left icon container and a right chevron. Used for settings, feature navigation, and creation shortcuts.

Toast.description: Transient notification that appears at the top of the screen for ~3s. Has a status icon, title, optional message, and close button.
Toast.rn_component: Animated.View (absolute positioned at top, slides in)

animation.appear: Slide down from top -60 to 0, opacity 0→1, duration 180ms

BottomSheet.description: Modal sheet that slides up from the bottom. Has a drag handle, scrim background, and content area.

animation.appear: Translate Y from +300 to 0, scrim opacity 0→1, duration 260ms
animation.dismiss: Translate Y from 0 to +300, scrim opacity 1→0, duration 220ms

ActionMenu.description: Contextual dropdown/popover with icon-labelled rows. Last item before a separator can be a destructive danger action.

Tooltip.description: Small floating label that appears above a target on long-press. Shows contextual help text.

arrow._note: Render with a rotated View (8x8, same background) positioned below the tooltip box

Tabs.description: Horizontal sub-navigation within a screen. Underline indicator slides to the active tab.

Breadcrumb.description: Horizontal navigation trail showing hierarchy. Separator is a forward slash.

Notification.description: Inline notification row in a feed or notification center. Status dot, title, body, and timestamp.

ChartCard.description: Data visualization container. Line/area chart on a dark grid. Feels like glowing instrumentation, not marketing graphics.

ProfileCard.description: User identity card. Avatar + name + role + plan badge, with a 3-column stat strip below.

SkeletonLoader.description: Animated shimmer placeholder displayed while content is loading.

EmptyState.description: Centered placeholder shown when a list or section has no content.

CodeBlock.description: Monospace code display. Dark deep background, syntax-colored text.

Divider.description: Horizontal separator. Two styles: plain hairline or labeled.

Rating.description: 5-star rating display. Filled stars in warning yellow, empty stars in disabled gray.

structure: TopBar with screen title and 1–2 icon action buttons
Horizontal scrollable row of 2–4 StatCards (equal width, flex: 1)
ChartCard (full width)
Section label (Micro + uppercase + tertiary)
Vertical list of ListItems or MenuCards
Vertical list of Notification items
home_dashboard.spacing: 16pt horizontal padding on all sides. 12pt gap between cards. 20pt between named sections.

structure: TopBar with back chevron + title
ProfileCard or hero StatCard (full width)
Tabs for sub-sections
Content section (list or chart) matching the active tab
Sticky bottom ButtonPrimary for the main action
TopBar with cancel (ghost button) + 'Create' title + optional step indicator
Scrollable form fields (TextInput, Picker, Toggle, etc.)
Section dividers between logical groups
BottomSheet for complex sub-selections
Fixed bottom ButtonPrimary (full width) as the primary CTA
creation_flow.notes: Use looser spacing in creation flows compared to dashboard density.

structure: TopBar
ProfileCard at top
Grouped MenuCards for each settings category (API, Security, Billing, etc.)
Danger zone section (red-tinted) at the bottom for destructive actions

iconography.style: Thin-line geometric. Fill: none. Stroke-based only.
iconography.library_recommendation: lucide-react-native or react-native-svg with custom SVG paths. Never use filled cartoon icons.
anti_patterns: No icons larger than 24pt in body content.
No multi-color icons (monochrome only, inheriting stroke color).

never_do: Never hardcode color values inline — always reference the token names from this document.
Never use a fontWeight not in ['400','500','600','700'].
Never place blue on anything that is not interactive or selected.
Never use backgroundColor: '#000000' for panels — use '#0F1011' (canvas) or '#1B1C1D' (panel).
Never use overflow: 'hidden' on a View that needs to show a shadow.
Never use white dividers — use rgba(255,255,255,0.04) or #2A2B2D only.
Never use more than one primary CTA button visible at the same time on a screen.
Never use illustrations or colorful decorative gradients in UI chrome.
Never set a borderRadius below 8 on interactive components.
always_do: Always align spacing to the 4pt grid.
Always use fontVariant: ['tabular-nums'] on any number that changes or is compared.
Always use SafeAreaView on screen root and account for bottom inset above tab bar.
Always animate state changes — never instant color/position switches (minimum 120ms).
Always provide a pressed/active visual state for every Pressable.
Always use tabular numbers (fontVariant) for stats, prices, and data values.
Always use sentence case for all UI text (not Title Case, not ALL CAPS unless micro label).
